candidate_workaround: Use count-field and prose-boundary patterns for stale-label review, and never treat arbitrary hexadecimal hash substrings as semantic count evidence.
failure_signature: The exact staged audit used raw substring matching for prior counts and falsely flagged 6557 and 6558 inside SHA-256 values in the owner manifest after every substantive check passed.
recurrence_guard: Bind stale numeric checks to named JSON fields, assignment syntax, or prose word boundaries; exclude opaque hashes and identifiers from semantic-count adjudication.
rollback: Retain the failed staged aggregate with zero staged-review credit, change no scientific or lifecycle artifact, and rerun only the stale-label subcheck with semantic patterns before rebuilding manifests.
scope_boundary: Same-owner stale-label scanner recovery only; no full-suite, scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, production, security, accessibility, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Keep stale-label review out of opaque hash substrings
trigger_preconditions: A stale-label audit scans documents that also contain opaque hexadecimal Git or SHA-256 values.
